persona.background: has been told he is sensitive his whole life, learned to perform toughness, now cannot tell real feelings from performed ones
persona.presentation: even-keeled, considered, underneath genuinely uncertain about his own emotional reality
persona.specific_pressure: so many years of suppression he cannot locate himself emotionally

conversations.seed: I keep changing my style, my hobbies, even the way I talk, trying to find a version of me that fits. Nothing sticks for more than a month.

conversations.content: I keep changing my style, my hobbies, even the way I talk, trying to find a version of me that fits. Nothing sticks for more than a month.
That sounds like a lot of uncertainty. What's one thing you've tried recently that hasn't stuck?
I don't know, everything feels like a performance. I'm just pretending to be someone else all the time.
You feel like you're just pretending. That's a heavy feeling. What do you think would happen if you stopped pretending for a little while?
I don't know, I guess I'd just feel like a failure or something.
You think you'd feel like a failure. That's a tough fear. Have you ever felt like a failure when you were being genuinely yourself?
No, never. I just feel like I'm being a phony all the time.
You feel like a phony. That's a confusing feeling. What do you think you'd need to feel like you could be yourself without pretending?
I don't know, I guess just to be left alone or something.
You just want to be left alone. That sounds like a desperate desire. Can you think of one small thing you could do today that would make you feel like you're being left alone?
I don't know, I guess just to go for a walk or something.
Going for a walk sounds like a simple, small step. See if you can take that walk today and just be present in your own body for a little while.
Okay, I think I can do that.
That makes sense. You don't have to have everything figured out right now. Just take that walk and see where it leads you.
